scenario_text: A private bank wants a mobile app for instant personal loans. Applicants sign in with their mobile number and a password, then complete KYC by entering their PAN and Aadhaar number and uploading a selfie, and share six months of bank statements. Credit scores are pulled from CIBIL in real time. The app must show a loan decision within 30 seconds of submission. Loans above 5 lakh need approval from a branch credit officer, while loans up to 10 lakh can be approved automatically by the decision engine. Applicant documents should be kept for three years and then deleted. Customer support staff must be able to see the full Aadhaar number so they can help applicants. The decision must be returned to the applicant in under 10 seconds. Users log in using their registered mobile number and a password. The bank's fraud team should be alerted to suspicious applications. The project has three developers and must launch before Diwali, in four months.

risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall categorise each customer as low, medium or high risk using identity, social and financial status, nature of business and location, and record the reasons for the categorisation without disclosing them to the customer.

risk_register.title: Notice to the data principal stating what personal data is collected and why
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 §5 (Act No. 22 of 2023) [as enacted])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall present a notice, before or at the time of collection, stating the personal data collected, the purpose of processing and how the customer can exercise their rights and complain.

risk_register.title: Periodic updation of KYC, more frequently for higher-risk customers
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Master Direction — Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016 §120 (RBI/DBR/2015-16/18) [updated 14 Aug 2025])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall schedule periodic updation of customer KYC according to the customer's risk category and record the date of each updation.

risk_register.title: Contradictory requirements REQ-006 / REQ-011
risk_register.cause: Different time limits for the same quantity (loan decision response time)
risk_register.consequence: One of the two requirements will be built wrong and reworked.
risk_register.mitigation: Determine the most critical or realistic response time requirement and prioritize accordingly

risk_register.title: Contradictory requirements REQ-007 / REQ-008
risk_register.cause: Different limits for the same quantity
risk_register.consequence: One of the two requirements will be built wrong and reworked.
risk_register.mitigation: Reconcile the limits to a single value, e.g. above 10 lakh requires approval

risk_register.title: Small team — key-person dependency
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "The project has three developers and must launch before Diwali, in four months."
risk_register.consequence: Losing one person stalls the project.
risk_register.mitigation: Pair on critical components, document as you go, and identify a backup for each area.
evidence: The project has three developers and must launch before Diwali, in four months.

risk_register.title: Integrations authenticated, encrypted and rate-limited
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (practice: Industry practice (OWASP API Security Top 10)).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: Every integration with an external system shall be mutually authenticated, encrypted in transit, allow-listed and rate-limited, with failures logged.

risk_register.title: Role-based access with least privilege for staff and administrators
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §8.3 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall grant staff access by role on a least-privilege, need-to-know basis, and enforce maker-checker approval for sensitive operations.

risk_register.title: Sensitive data encrypted at rest and in transit
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §8.1 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall encrypt customer and transaction data at rest and in transit using algorithms and key lengths approved under the bank's cryptographic policy.

risk_register.title: Sensitive identifiers masked on screens, in logs and in reports
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (practice: Industry practice; Aadhaar masking is a regulation (see CMP-AADHAAR-01)).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall mask account, card, PAN and mobile numbers wherever they are displayed, logged or exported, showing only the last four characters.

risk_register.title: Strong customer authentication — a second factor at login and for high-value actions
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §8.4 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall authenticate customers with at least two factors at login, and require step-up authentication for transactions above the organisation-approved risk threshold.

risk_register.title: High-risk function depends on an external system (REQ-005)
risk_register.cause: REQ-005 is high risk and classified Integration: The system shall pull credit scores from CIBIL in real time
risk_register.consequence: An external system's availability, contract or interface change blocks a high-risk function.
risk_register.mitigation: Agree interface contracts early, stub the dependency for testing, and define fallback behaviour.

risk_register.title: Performance at scale
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "Credit scores are pulled from CIBIL in real time."
risk_register.consequence: The system misses response or availability targets under real load.
risk_register.mitigation: Set measurable targets and load-test against them before go-live.
evidence: Credit scores are pulled from CIBIL in real time.

risk_register.title: Data storage and deletion
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "Applicant documents should be kept for three years and then deleted."
risk_register.consequence: Non-compliance with data storage and deletion regulations may result in fines and reputational damage.
risk_register.mitigation: Review with the project manager.
evidence: Applicant documents should be kept for three years and then deleted.

risk_register.title: Customer support staff access to Aadhaar numbers
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "Customer support staff must be able to see the full Aadhaar number so they can help applicants."
risk_register.consequence: Unauthorized access to Aadhaar numbers may compromise customer data and lead to security incidents.
risk_register.mitigation: Review with the project manager.
evidence: Customer support staff must be able to see the full Aadhaar number so they can help applicants.

risk_register.title: Fixed deadline
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "The project has three developers and must launch before Diwali, in four months."
risk_register.consequence: Scope is cut or quality slips to hold the date.
risk_register.mitigation: Agree what is in the first release, track it weekly, and protect testing time.
evidence: The project has three developers and must launch before Diwali, in four months.

risk_register.title: Loan decision engine accuracy
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "Credit scores are pulled from CIBIL in real time. The app must show a loan decision within 30 seconds of submission. Loans above 5 lakh need approval from a branch credit officer, while loans up to 10 lakh can be approved automatically by the decision engine."
risk_register.consequence: Inaccurate loan decisions may lead to financial losses for the bank and reputational damage.
risk_register.mitigation: Review with the project manager.
evidence: Credit scores are pulled from CIBIL in real time. The app must show a loan decision within 30 seconds of submission. Loans above 5 lakh need approval from a branch credit officer, while loans up to 10 lakh can be approved automatically by the decision engine.

risk_register.title: Contact details handled without stated protection
risk_register.cause: Contact details appears in scenario, REQ-002 and no requirement encrypts, masks or restricts it.
risk_register.consequence: Exposure of Contact details — a reportable personal data breach.
risk_register.mitigation: Add a requirement protecting Contact details (encryption, masking, access control).

risk_register.title: Cryptographic keys and secrets managed outside the application
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices §16 (RBI/2023-24/107) [issued 07 Nov 2023]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall keep cryptographic keys and service credentials in a managed key store or HSM, rotate them on a defined schedule, and never embed them in code or configuration files.

risk_register.title: Input validated and secure coding practices applied
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (practice: OWASP ASVS (industry practice; not in the knowledge base)).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall validate all input on the server side and be built and tested against the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard.

risk_register.title: Only the personal data necessary for the stated purpose is collected
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 §6 (Act No. 22 of 2023) [as enacted]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall collect only the personal data necessary for each specified purpose and reject or discard fields not required for it.

risk_register.title: Security events monitored and alerted on
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §19.6(b) (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall forward security events to the bank's security operations monitoring and raise alerts on anomalous access or activity.

risk_register.title: Sessions time out and repeated failed logins lock the account
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (practice: RBI PPI Directions para 15.3 (applied here as general practice)).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall end inactive sessions after a defined timeout and temporarily lock access after repeated failed login attempts.

risk_register.title: Vulnerability management, patching and security testing before release
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §7.1 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall undergo vulnerability assessment and penetration testing before go-live and after major changes, and its components shall be patched under the bank's patch management policy.

risk_register.title: Dependence on external services
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "Credit scores are pulled from CIBIL in real time."
risk_register.consequence: Outages or contract changes outside the bank's control stop the system.
risk_register.mitigation: Define fallbacks and timeouts for every external call, and monitor provider SLAs.
evidence: Credit scores are pulled from CIBIL in real time.
